what: CI drift enforcement is not actually wired
scenario_or_breakage: The plan says compose lint-foreground into local make lint, but CI runs make lint-only plus sharded make test-harnesses-N, so marker drift can pass CI despite the acceptance criterion
suggested_fix: Wire lint-foreground into an actual CI path, e.g. a pass_filenames:false pre-commit hook used by make lint-only, an explicit CI step, or a sharded test-harness target; add the harness to exactly one test-harnesses-N shard

what: Linter detection is too narrow for existing command-substitution invocations
scenario_or_breakage: The planned leading-command detector can miss Family B calls wrapped as assignments like _plan_review_dispatch=$(".../dispatch-with-waterfall.sh" ...) and _plan_voter_dispatch=$(".../dispatch-plan-voters.sh" ...), leaving required markers unenforced
suggested_fix: Add parser coverage for denylisted basenames inside executable shell lines including command substitutions and assignment prefixes; add fixtures for var=$("${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/foo.sh" ...)

what: The confirmed review-and-fix.sh invocation is left unmarked when it is prose-only
scenario_or_breakage: The feature acceptance requires every Family B invocation in skills paths to have both markers, but the plan leaves review-and-fix.sh prose references alone if no fenced invocation exists
suggested_fix: Convert the imperative review-and-fix.sh run instruction into a fenced bash block with the canonical banner and inline comment, or explicitly revise the acceptance scope if prose command invocations are intentionally excluded
